coverageNotes: TOOLING LIMITS: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted after the first eight queries (Britannia, Titan, Himalaya, Page, UB, USL, AB InBev), and WebFetch was then rate-limited or refused (403/503) by many corporate sites (Biocon, Syngene, Prestige, RMZ, Coffee Day, Kirloskar Electric, ABB, 3M, Hitachi Energy, Toyota, Bosch, Ujjivan, CreditAccess, Shriram Properties, TTK Prestige, Canara Bank footer). Where a primary page was unreachable the address comes from well-known exchange-filing registered-office addresses and the coordinate from an OSM polygon/POI or an area-level geocode, and confidence is lowered accordingly (stated in each evidence sentence). VERIFIED FROM PRIMARY PAGES in this run: Titan (3 offices), Himalaya, Strides (corporate + R&D), Micro Labs, Dynamatic (3 sites), Centum, Triveni Turbine, Hical, Gokaldas, Anthem, HCG, Sakra, Jana SFB, Can Fin Homes, KMF, Embassy Group, Sattva, Brigade, Sobha, Puravankara, Wipro Consumer Care (2), Diageo India; from exchange filings/LEI: Britannia, Page, UB, USL. OSM-ONLY placements (medium/low): AB InBev GCC, SKF, Timken, Denso Kirloskar, Volvo (3), Schneider (2), Bagmane, Toyota second site, Bosch satellite offices, ABB Rajajinagar/Mahadevapura, Vistaar, Mindteck Bommanahalli. AREA-LEVEL PINS (confidence low, said so): Britannia Bidadi, Bosch Bidadi, Kirloskar Electric, Gokaldas, Himatsingka, CreditAccess Grameen, Shriram Properties, Page's Jockey campus, Titan Annexe. LEFT OUT: Kirloskar Systems (site unreachable, HQ at Kirloskar Business Park not verifiable); Century Real Estate, Divyasree, Bhartiya Urban, Total Environment, Mantri (no verifiable address); Tata Coffee (merged into Tata Consumer Products Jan 2024; former HQ Kumara Park West) and Fincare SFB (merged into AU SFB Apr 2024; HQ Sarjapur Road) were considered as 'closed' entries but omitted because no primary source could be fetched; Karnataka Bank (Mangaluru HQ), Apollo, Equitas, Five Star (Chennai), Bajaj (Pune), Jubilant (Noida), Akzo Nobel (Gurugram; its Bengaluru plant unverified), Berger, Kalyani Group (Pune) are outside the lens. Triveni Turbine's Sompura plant (KIADB Sompura, Nelamangala, ~77.33E) and Himatsingka's Doddaballapur plant fall outside the 77.35-77.90 / 12.75-13.25 box and are excluded; Titan's Hosur plant likewise. CATEGORY JUDGEMENTS: Gokaldas Exports marked MNC under the literal rule (listed, >10,000 employees, African subsidiaries); Narayana Health and Manipal kept MID_SIZE despite large headcounts because they are domestic hospital chains; KMF is a cooperative, not government-owned, so MID_SIZE rather than PSU; United Breweries, SKF, Timken, Kennametal, 3M, Yokogawa, Hitachi Energy and ABB India are Indian-listed/incorporated but tagged MNC/Foreign by parent HQ per rule 2. Electronics City Phase 1/2 coordinates are a Nominatim point and an OSM-tenant centroid respectively because OSM holds no phase polygons; no headcounts or sizes are asserted (all null) because no source stating them was fetched.
